messages:

Date: 2027-05-04T09:12:00Z
Subject: Post-demo: Privacy & security follow-up + DPA/SCC next steps

Hi Ana — thanks again for the demo earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep contracting moving: 

Recap (high level):
- ProspectX will use Redwood to generate personalized customer messaging for EU users.
- Data involved: customer names, email addresses, user-provided content (support transcripts), and anonymized product usage signals.
- Primary concern on today’s call: GDPR DPA, SCC module selection, SOC 2 evidence, and retention/pseudonymization requirements.

Proposed immediate actions (our suggested order):
1) Confirm data flow / roles: please confirm whether ProspectX will be Controller for the data processed by Redwood (your team indicated yes; tagging below) — we’ll treat Redwood as Processor in the DPA strawman.
2) Vendor security questionnaire (VSQ): you mentioned you’d share the VSQ. Once received we’ll have Solutions + Security pick up and return a completed VSQ + SOC 2 summary within 3 business days.
3) DPA + SCC module: our recommendation for this SaaS use case is Controller (ProspectX) -> Processor (Redwood) and SCC Module 2 (controller-to-processor). If you have a required SCC module preference, let us know.
4) Provide SOC 2 evidence: attaching a short SOC 2 summary and a proposed DPA draft for your legal team to review (see attachments).
5) Scheduling: if useful, Monica (copied) can run a 30-min technical/infosec walk-through with your security lead next week.

Tentative timeline: aim to exchange redlines and final DPA within 2–3 weeks (target close by 2027-05-21) to align with the pilot start.

Please confirm the controller/processor designation and share the VSQ when you’re able — we’ll queue legal to prioritize.

Thanks,
Maya Srinivasan
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
maya@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

From: Ana Gomez <ana.gomez@prospectx.com>

Date: 2027-05-04T13:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Privacy & security follow-up + DPA/SCC next steps

Thanks Maya — appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Controller/processor: ProspectX will be Controller for end-customer data. Redwood will be Processor for the features discussed.
- SCC module: our legal team generally prefers SCC Module 2 (controller -> processor) but has asked whether Redwood can support Module 1 in specific cross-border scenarios — can you confirm?
- Hosting/regions: we need all EU customer data to be processed and stored in the EU region; please confirm if you support EU-only hosting for our tenant.
- HIPAA: not applicable for this pilot, but FYI some of our later pilots may involve PHI — will Redwood support HIPAA BAA discussions later?

Attached our VSQ (ProspectX_VSQ_20270504.pdf). Please return the completed VSQ and SOC 2 evidence. Legal also asked for an editable DPA to start redlines — we’ll route to legal once we have your DPA file.

We’re aiming to review DPA redlines internally the week of 2027-05-17. If you can confirm EU-only hosting and SCC module support this week, that will help accelerate.

Best,
Ana Gomez

Subject: Re: Post-demo: Privacy & security follow-up + DPA/SCC next steps

Thanks Ana — Monica here from Solutions/Trust. Quick answers + a DPA strawman and evidence summary attached for legal to start redlines.

Short answers up front:
- Controller/Processor: Confirmed — we will be Processor. We’ll include standard processor obligations in the DPA, including subprocessors, data subject rights support, and audit cooperation clauses.
- SCC module: For the Controller -> Processor relationship you described, SCC Module 2 is the correct module and is what we’ll include by default. We also support Module 1 scenarios when ProspectX is initiating transfers where you are the exporter and Redwood is receiving as processor; we can add Module 1 as an alternative clause if legal prefers.
- EU-only hosting: Yes — we can provision your tenant in our EU region and restrict the tenant data plane to EU-only storage and processing. We’ll document the region restriction in the DPA and the onboarding checklist.
- HIPAA/BaaS: We do offer a HIPAA-ready path; we can discuss a separate BAA once you confirm scope — pilot does not require it.

Attachments sent: Redwood_DPA_Proposed_v1.pdf (editable), Redwood_SOC2_Summary_2026.pdf (summary). I completed the VSQ where straightforward and flagged a couple of items for Infosec review — sending back as a separate file by EOD.

Next suggested steps: 
1) Legal to review the attached DPA and return high-level redlines by 2027-05-17. (Owner: ProspectX legal)
2) Redwood to provision EU-only tenant and provide onboarding checklist (Owner: Monica) — will confirm staging ETA by 2027-05-07.
3) Infosec deep-dive (optional technical call) — propose 2027-05-06 or 2027-05-10, 30 minutes.

If that timeline works we’ll slot this for priority so pilot start dates are unaffected.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer, Trust Programs | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwoodinference.com
